caption: Data parallelism: each GPU takes 32 images through the full model in a 90 ms step (80 ms compute, then a 10 ms gradient all-reduce). Model parallelism: layers 1–6 take 40 ms, the 100 MB activation takes 30 ms on the link, so the first output from layers 7–12 arrives at 110 ms; after that a new micro-batch leaves every 40 ms.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds. Two data-parallel GPUs each run 32 images for 90 ms and finish together. In the model-parallel pipeline, GPU 0 runs layers 1–6 for 40 ms, a 30 ms link transfer carries the activation, and GPU 1 runs layers 7–12, so the first output appears at 110 ms and then one micro-batch every 40 ms.
